cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one French poker playing-card BACK for a Unity memory game, labeled A. Portrait canvas 1024x1536. Exactly ONE flat orthographic card, centered, thin black rounded rectangular outer outline around x50,y75 to x974,y1461. Opaque ivory white rim, inset navy blue rectangular patterned back. Elegant classic casino engraving, restrained symmetrical gold geometric lattice and delicate gold double-line border on navy. At the exact center a large round navy medallion with a fine gold ring and a single very large bold ivory uppercase serif letter. Text verbatim: "A". Only that ONE letter, no corner letters, no ranks, no suits, no other text. The letter must be plainly legible at thumbnail size. Symmetric ornament, crisp clean flat printing, no gradients, shadows, perspective, tabletop, texture, watermark, logos. Both card face and outside background fully opaque. Outside the card pure white, artwork all opaque. Maintain a white margin between black outer outline and navy panel so the black outline is separate from the dark artwork. This is the master design for a matching set of 16 backs where only the central letter changes.
